title: GeneralizedSmoothConvexPolynomialDimension.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained convex minimization of f: ℝ^d → ℝ, with an attained global minimum and some minimizer xstar satisfying ‖x0 − xstar‖ ≤ R.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: One oracle returns ∇f(x) at any queried x ∈ ℝ^d. Every history and oracle seed must return the exact gradient; function values are not supplied. Algorithms may be randomized and have unrestricted query points and outputs.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, HasGradientAt clause; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexPolynomialDimension.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm, Setup.allowedAlgorithm, executeWithTrace.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is differentiable everywhere and ‖D(∇f)(x)‖ ≤ L0 + L1‖∇f(x)‖ globally, with L0,L1 > 0. No global constant bound on the Hessian or gradient is assumed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, Differentiable and fderiv clauses; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexPolynomialDimension.lean: spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Euclidean space ℝ^d with d ≥ ⌈17592186044416(1 + L1R)^5⌉.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters d,L0,L1,x0,R,ε are public. R > 0 bounds distance to a minimizer; no initial objective-gap bound is supplied. The parameter regime requires L1R ≥ 1048576.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Output any point X ∈ ℝ^d with integrable objective gap and E[f(X) − f(xstar)] ≤ ε for a global minimizer xstar. The accuracy regime is L0/L1² ≤ ε ≤ L0R²/16, with ε > 0.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee is in expectation over algorithm and oracle seeds; no almost-sure or high-probability accuracy requirement is imposed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines convex generalized smoothness and radius-only initialization information with a prescribed large-L1R accuracy regime and an explicit polynomial dimension threshold.

descriptionHtml:
Generalized Smoothness in Polynomial Dimension

We consider minimizing a convex function f:Rd→R in a dimension d∈N subject to a polynomial lower bound. The function f is (L0,L1)-smooth, with L0,L1>0: its differentiable gradient satisfies ∥∇2f(x)∥op≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥ at every x∈Rd. A given point x0 lies within distance R>0 of a global minimizer x⋆. The oracle returns ∇f(x) at x. For ε>0, the goal is an output x¯ with EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Rdf(x). We use the Euclidean norm, and ∥⋅∥op denotes the induced operator norm. The algorithm receives d, L0, L1, x0, R, and ε.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Parameter regime). The positive parameters satisfy L1R≥1048576,L0L12≤ε≤L0R216,d≥⌈17592186044416(1+L1R)5⌉.

Assumption 2 (Convexity). For every x,y∈Rd and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y).

Assumption 3 (Generalized smoothness). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere, its gradient is Fréchet differentiable everywhere, and ∥∇2f(x)∥op≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥,x∈Rd. Here ∇2f(x) is a linear operator from Rd to Rd.

Assumption 4 (Initial distance). There exists x⋆∈Rd such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈Rd,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Queries may be made at any point of Rd. After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯∈Rd must have an integrable objective gap and satisfy EP[|f(x¯)−f(x⋆)|]<∞,EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε. The minimizer is fixed independently of the algorithm’s randomness; all global minimizers have the same objective value.

comparisonHtml:
Convex twice differentiable f:Rd→R satisfies ∥∇2f(x)∥≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥ and has a minimizer x⋆ with ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R; no initial-gap bound. Parameters are positive, q=L1R≥220, L0/L12≤ε≤L0R2/16, and d≥⌈244(1+q)5⌉. Algorithms may be arbitrary randomized adaptive exact-gradient algorithms. The target is an integrable objective gap with ∫[f(x^(ω))−f(x⋆)]dP(ω)≤ε, where P is the algorithm’s probability law.

import LongTails.Setups.RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic

namespace LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothConvexPolynomialDimension

open OracleTemplate MeasureTheory

structure Params where
  d : ℕ
  L0 : ℝ
  L1 : ℝ
  x0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

noncomputable abbrev Params.toRadiusOnly (p : Params) : RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.Params :=
  { E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d), L0 := p.L0, L1 := p.L1, x0 := p.x0,
    R := p.R, ε := p.ε }

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d) → ℝ
  Query p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Reply p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Output p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  publicInput := id
  valid p := 0 < p.L0 ∧ 0 < p.L1 ∧ 0 < p.R ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧
    1048576 ≤ p.L1 * p.R ∧ p.L0 / p.L1 ^ 2 ≤ p.ε ∧ p.ε ≤ p.L0 * p.R ^ 2 / 16 ∧
    ⌈17592186044416 * (1 + p.L1 * p.R) ^ 5⌉₊ ≤ p.d
  admissible p := RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.spec.admissible p.toRadiusOnly
  successful p f output P :=
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => f (output ω) - f xstar) (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, f (output ω) - f xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothConvexPolynomialDimension
